Files.title: Files
Files.body: Files is this workspace’s filing cabinet: a folder tree, a searchable list and a detail drawer. A file can attach to any record, a contact, a payment or a journal entry, and carries its versions with it, so earlier states stay accessible. Folder, search and selection live in the address; a filtered view can therefore be shared as a link.
